records.title: Experimental trials to assess the risks of decompression sickness in flying after diving

protocol.context: Resting hypobaric chamber flight after dry simulated diving. Repeat participants possible.

discrepancy.flagged_arm: Three repetitive dives with a 14-hour preflight interval

case_profiles.symptoms: Calf cramp on leaving the chamber.
case_profiles.resolution: Lasted four hours and resolved spontaneously.

case_profiles.symptoms: Progressive foot pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Altered elbow sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Unchanged for a day before resolving during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Knee soreness and tingling, with later reduced pinprick in the leg.
case_profiles.resolution: Worsened the next day and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Arm pain with paresthesias.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved during descent, returned over 12 hours. Mild soreness remained after treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Shoulder pain and altered arm sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Residual shoulder tightness after treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Foot tingling spread to the thigh.
case_profiles.resolution: Unchanged during descent and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Tingling on the right side of the body.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved 30 minutes after flight.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hand tingling followed by arm soreness, fullness and stiffness in the wrist and hand.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved spontaneously after 12 hours.

case_profiles.symptoms: Warmth and tingling on the ball of the foot.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during descent 30 minutes later.

case_profiles.symptoms: Moderate arm pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved during descent and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hand tingling and mild shoulder pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Unchanged during descent and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: In-flight shoulder pain, followed 90 minutes after flight by disorientation, nausea and difficulty with serial subtraction.
case_profiles.resolution: Shoulder pain lasted 23 minutes. The later symptoms resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hand numbness, tingling and decreased grip strength.
case_profiles.treatment: USN Table 6, then hyperbaric oxygen the next day
case_profiles.resolution: Improved with the first treatment and resolved after the second.

case_profiles.symptoms: Foot numbness.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Knee pain was greater standing or walking than seated.
case_profiles.resolution: Present at bedtime and resolved by morning.

case_profiles.symptoms: Transient arm pain progressed to tingling and repeatedly returned overnight.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved by morning.

case_profiles.symptoms: Intermittent foot cramp.
case_profiles.resolution: Persisted until descent.

case_profiles.symptoms: Mild fatigue and a dull shoulder ache reported during the 24-hour call.
case_profiles.resolution: Symptoms lasted two hours.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hip and knee discomfort, leg tingling and calf cramps.
case_profiles.resolution: Almost resolved during treatment and fully resolved the next day.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hand paresthesia and forearm tingling.
case_profiles.resolution: Symptoms lasted one hour and resolved before descent.

case_profiles.symptoms: Elbow pain and reduced hand sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent. Slightly reduced fine touch persisted on the palm after treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Calf pain and reduced pinprick.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Hip pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Burning, fullness and tingling of the hand.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during descent at 4,000 ft.

case_profiles.symptoms: Knee pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent, nearly cleared on surface oxygen, and resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Mild constant knee pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved 81 minutes later before descent.

case_profiles.symptoms: Altered hand sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Reduced intensity 25 hours after onset, then resolved by the next day.

case_profiles.symptoms: Reduced arm sensation and pinprick in a C5 distribution.
case_profiles.resolution: Mild residual numbness cleared by the next day.

case_profiles.symptoms: Mild elbow pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent and resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Bilateral forearm pain and paresthesias.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent and surface oxygen. Resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Shoulder and elbow pain and reduced hand sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent and resolved on surface oxygen before hyperbaric treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Elbow pain recurred after flight and after a hot shower, with numbness over the deltoid.
case_profiles.resolution: The initial pain resolved in 30 minutes. Recurring symptoms resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Dull shoulder pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved during descent and treatment. Resolved by the 48-hour check.

case_profiles.symptoms: Mild elbow pain.
case_profiles.resolution: Lasted two hours and resolved spontaneously before descent.

case_profiles.symptoms: Arm pain, tingling, numbness and altered thermal sensation.
case_profiles.resolution: Initially cleared on surface oxygen, returned on air, and resolved during hyperbaric treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Tingling and numbness of the hand, forearm and foot.
case_profiles.treatment: USN Table 6 followed by hyperbaric oxygen
case_profiles.resolution: Foot symptoms cleared with the first treatment and residual hand numbness with the second.

case_profiles.symptoms: Sharp arm pain progressed to numbness.
case_profiles.resolution: Improved on descent. Remaining shoulder soreness cleared the next day.

case_profiles.symptoms: Arm tingling, coldness, numbness and reduced strength.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during treatment.

case_profiles.symptoms: Worsening right elbow discomfort, followed after descent by right hand tingling and numbness.
case_profiles.resolution: Resolved during treatment. Appendix A describes a separate preflight shoulder complaint during the same profile.

records.title: Decompression sickness and flying after diving
records.note: The preliminary report uses four of the later protocols and separates ambiguous, mild and serious cases. Exact trial membership within the final report is unavailable. The preliminary rows are retained as provenance without additional outcome counts.

records.title: Decompression sickness (DCS) risk at 35,000 feet
records.note: The same altitude, 75-minute oxygen prebreathe, three-hour maximum and cycling workload appear in the later Webb 35,000-ft article. Later enrollment differs. Neither person overlap nor exact early case numerators are inferred.

records.title: Zero-preoxygenation decompression sickness risk at 25,000 feet
records.note: The later zero-preoxygenation paper includes the same altitude, mild exercise, oxygen at altitude and four-hour maximum. The later 25,000-ft group has a different denominator. Exact linkage and early case numerators are unavailable.
